findings.title: Light-theme color for meta-data h5 links changes from 30% to 70% lightness, and the pair is inverted.
findings.body: The old value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new light branch uses 70%, which makes the reply-to username links in the topic meta-data much paler on light themes. The dark branch is 30%, so the two values are swapped compared with every other conversion in this PR, which maps X% to (100-X)%. The PR only asked to add a dark-theme variant. Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Light-theme color for group member name changes from 30% to 50% lightness.
findings.body: The old value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new light branch uses 50%, so `.group-member-info .name` gets paler on light themes, which this change was not asked to do. Keep 30% for light and use 70% for dark: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Mobile custom-message-length light color changes from 70% to 30%, and the dark color is inverted.
findings.body: The old value was 70% lightness. The new light branch uses 30%, which makes the hint much darker on light themes. The dark branch uses 70%, which makes it very bright on dark themes. The desktop sibling in desktop/modal.scss correctly uses (70%, 30%). Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Mobile topic-map h3 light color changes from 20% to 50% lightness.
findings.body: The old value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new light branch uses 50%, so the heading is noticeably paler on light themes. The desktop sibling keeps (20%, 80%). Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.

findings.title: Mobile group member name light color changes from 30% to 50% lightness.
findings.body: This is the same regression as in the desktop file. The original light value of 30% is replaced by 50%, which changes how light themes look. Use `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.
